rule Suspicious_Outlook_Powershell {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Outlook spawning PowerShell with hidden window and encoded command"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1566.001"
        date = "2026-04-12"
    strings:
        $powershell = "powershell.exe" nocase
        $encoded = "-encodedcommand" nocase
        $hidden = "-w hidden" nocase
        $parent_outlook = "outlook.exe" nocase
    condition:
        process.parent.name matches $parent_outlook and
        process.name matches $powershell and
        $powershell in command_line and
        $encoded in command_line and
        $hidden in command_line
}
